ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white and tan) pixels across approximately 75% of the fluke surface, framed by low-intensity (black/dark) pixels along the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the central lobes. Significant tan/beige mottling is localized in the medial section of the left lobe and sub-terminal region of the right lobe. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid band along the trailing edge and a vertical wedge at the fluke's central axis leading to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple sharp peaks (5-20 pixel amplitude) and varying valley depths are visible along the entire boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral edges, tapering to sharp, low-intensity points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, irregular pixel clusters localized on the extreme distal tips, particularly on the left lobe, indicating likely barnacle attachment sites or residual scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, low-intensity linear marks are visible on the right lobe, oriented perpendicularly to the trailing edge and disrupting the white pigmentation map.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged trailing edge topography suggests cumulative physical wear; a prominent vertical low-intensity band extends from the submerged peduncle area toward the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan/ochre-colored surface staining covering large segments of the high-intensity ventral regions, particularly on the left lobe's medial surface.
